verdict.rationale: Jitsu's docs say it is "100% open-source" and self-deployable, and its source repo is public at github.com/jitsucom/jitsu. A community user confirms running the open-source version, and the llms.txt describes Jitsu as an open-source platform. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (e.g. MIT/Apache) and no license terms are documented, so whether every component, including the Kubernetes operator and function servers, is under an open license is not shown.
